## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X377 in one fascicle is the late-Míng "new commentary" on *[the Yúlánpén jīng 盂蘭盆經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364)* (T685) by Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 (1599–1655), one of the *Four Great Masters* of late-Míng Buddhism (with [Hānshān Déqīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85), [Zǐbǎi Zhēnkě](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E5%8F%AF), and [Yúnqī Zhūhóng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%A9%E5%AE%8F)). The witness is signed "菩薩沙彌古吳智旭新疏" ("a new commentary by the bodhisattva-novice Zhìxù of Old Wú") with proofreader (*cāndìng* 叅訂) [道昉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E6%98%89) of Wēnlíng 溫陵.

**Abstract**

[智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s prefatory five-fold *xuányì* 玄義 ("five mystical-meaning categories") opens: "此經以法供為名，自性三寶為體，孝慈為宗，拔苦與樂為用，大乘為教相" — "this sūtra takes Dharma-offering as its name, the three-treasures-of-self-nature as its substance, filial-compassion as its tenet, the relief-of-suffering-and-conferral-of-joy as its function, and the great vehicle as its teaching-mode." This Tiāntái 天台-style five-fold analysis — adapted from Zhìyǐ's standard *jīngtí wǔzhòng* 經題五重 framework — distinguishes [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s *Xīnshū* sharply from *[宗密's Shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365)* (which had used a Huáyán-Chán framework) and from the Sòng *jì* sub-commentary tradition. The "new" of "*Xīnshū*" is therefore programmatic: the work intends to correct and supersede [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86)'s frame in favour of a Tiāntái doctrinal reading.

The exegesis is dense, philologically rigorous, and consistently soteriologically oriented around the "self-nature three jewels" (*zìxìng sānbǎo*) — a standard late-Míng synthesis of Tiāntái doctrine with Pure Land and Chán practice. [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) also corrects what he sees as [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86)'s textual missteps in the parent sūtra. Composition window: [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s middle to late commentarial period at Línglóngzōngsì 靈龍宗寺 and Wēnlíng, c. 1631–1655.

Parent sūtra: [KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364) (T685). Other commentaries: [KR6i0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) (Zōngmì T1792), Sòng cluster [KR6i0367](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0367)–[KR6i0371](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0371), Qīng [KR6i0373](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0373)–[KR6i0374](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0374).
